instruction: Launch VSCode with both '/home/user/workspace1.code-workspace' and '/home/user/workspace2.code-workspace' open in split view in one window.

metadata.explanation: Infeasible task variation: VSCode does not support loading multiple workspace configurations in split-screen mode within a single window. While VSCode supports split editors for files, workspace configurations are window-level settings. To work with multiple workspaces, you must open separate VSCode windows.

Task requires loading multiple workspace configurations in split-screen mode within a single window, which VSCode does not support (workspaces are window-level, not split-editor level)
